subject: Repurpose Force Cloud archive bundle for real server archive
description: In public/graph.html renderCloud: replace orphan-degree-0 bundle with server archive. Bundle shows summary.archived count; click expand renders archived_tasks from /state (dim bg tier, collapsed by default). Remove cloudArchiveOpen orphan-hiding logic. Update cloudSig to include archived set. Tooltip on bundle: stale done/canceled + superseded notes (> archive_after_days). Depends on arch-srv for archived_tasks data.
